content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> * The Chao Phraya Princess Dinner Cruise offers a 2.5-hour luxury double-deck cruiser experience, departing from ICONSIAM pier, showcasing illuminated landmarks like the Grand Palace and Wat Arun. Guests enjoy an international/Thai buffet or plated dinner with live jazz/pop music.
> * This year-round experience, requiring advance booking, features a "Romantic, Scenic, Relaxing" atmosphere with no physical demand, ideal for a romantic evening. AGS provides priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers.
> * The cruise specifically passes under the Rama VIII bridge and directly in front of Wat Arun, offering prime photographic opportunities of its mosaic-covered prang. A smart casual dress code is universally respected for this luxury experience.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Dine on a luxury double-deck cruiser, viewing the brilliantly illuminated Grand Palace and Wat Arun from the serene vantage point of the 'River of Kings'.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Taking advantage of the stunning lighting of Bangkok's riverside heritage sites, luxury operators transformed basic transport barges into premium, floating fine-dining rooms.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Board the cruiser at the ICONSIAM pier. As the boat drifts under the Rama VIII bridge, you enjoy a massive international and Thai buffet or a bespoke plated dinner. 

A live jazz or pop band plays soft music. The highlight is passing directly in front of Wat Arun (The Temple of Dawn), its massive, mosaic-covered prang glowing fiercely against the night sky, providing an unmatched photographic opportunity.

| Metric | Details |

## Effortless Riverfront Dining After 18 Holes at Thai Country Club, Ballyshear or Nikanti
After a full morning battling the water hazards of [Thai Country Club](/courses/thailand/thai-country-club/), the strategic bunkers of [Ballyshear Golf Links](/courses/thailand/ballyshear/), or the fast undulations of [Alpine Golf Club](/courses/thailand/alpine-golf-club/) and [Nikanti Golf Club](/courses/thailand/nikanti/), boarding the **Chao Phraya Princess Dinner Cruise** at ICONSIAM Pier or Asiatique The Riverfront at 7:30 PM gives your group a zero-walking, breeze-cooled perspective on Bangkok’s illuminated royal landmarks.

For travelers staying at [Riva Surya Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/riva-surya-bangkok/) (located right along the northern loop of the cruise route near Rama VIII Bridge) or transferring 15 minutes from [Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/sindhorn-kempinski/), the two-hour voyage glides past the golden spires of the Grand Palace, the glowing porcelain prang of Wat Arun, Wat Kalayanamit, and Memorial Bridge.

## Upper-Deck Open-Air Table Allocation & ICONSIAM Pre-Drinks
* **Guaranteed Open-Air Upper Deck Seating:** Standard cruise vouchers often seat guests inside the enclosed lower cabin where window glare blocks photography of Wat Arun; Asia Golf Specialists exclusively books upper-deck open-air bow or rail tables for unobstructed river breezes and 360-degree night skylines.
* **ICONSIAM Cocktail Pre-Game:** Arrive at ICONSIAM 60 minutes prior to boarding to enjoy a craft cocktail on the *Tasana Nakorn Terrace* overlooking the river bends before your host escorts your party through priority VIP boarding on your [Bangkok & Hua Hin](/tours/bangkok-hua-hin/) golf holiday.

## Pairing Your River Cruise With Bangkok’s Premier Championship Golf Rotation
During our [Bangkok & Hua Hin](/tours/bangkok-hua-hin/) and [Thailand Ultimate Golf](/tours/thailand-ultimate-golf/) itineraries, we love slotting the Chao Phraya Princess Dinner Cruise onto the evening of your opening round at [Thai Country Club](/courses/thailand/thai-country-club/), [Ballyshear Golf Links](/courses/thailand/ballyshear/), or [Alpine Golf Club](/courses/thailand/alpine-golf-club/). Because the vessel docks back at ICONSIAM by 9:30 PM, guests staying at [Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/sindhorn-kempinski/) or [Riva Surya Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/riva-surya-bangkok/) are tucked into bed by 10:15 PM—fully rested for the next morning’s tee sheet at [Nikanti Golf Club](/courses/thailand/nikanti/).

faqs.q: Where does the Chao Phraya Princess Dinner Cruise board in Bangkok?
faqs.a: The cruise boards at ICONSIAM Pier 2 (or Asiatique The Riverfront) at 7:15 PM for a 7:30 PM departure—just 15 minutes by private SUV or shuttle boat from Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok and Riva Surya Bangkok.

faqs.q: How does Asia Golf Specialists ensure our golf group gets open-air upper-deck seating?
faqs.a: We reserve upper-deck open-air tables in advance (or private boutique teak rice-barge charters like Manohra and Loy Pela Voyages for smaller luxury groups) so your party enjoys unobstructed views of Wat Arun and the Grand Palace.

faqs.q: Can we pair a morning round at Thai Country Club with the Chao Phraya Dinner Cruise?
faqs.a: Yes. A 7:30 AM tee time at Thai Country Club or Ballyshear Golf Links returns you to your Bangkok hotel by 1:30 PM, leaving five hours to rest and dress before your 6:45 PM transfer to ICONSIAM Pier.
